feeds.title: Ana's Attic Book Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am Ana, and I started this blog at the beginning of 2012. Originally started to help women find books to read after Fifty Shades of Grey, it has expanded to include all kinds of romance. My reviews are detailed with some favorite quotes from the book, my Likes and Dislikes, and I always include a 'Down & Dirty' review which is for those of you who like a brief review.

feeds.title: Maryse's Book Blog
feeds.description: I am a book addict, born and raised in Canada. Reading is my favorite! I love blogging about books, reviewing them, making 'favorites lists' & reading order guides, & hearing your own 5-star recommendations to add to my TBR list!

feeds.title: Florida Bookman Blog
feeds.description: have been a book collector, writer, and historian for more than 45 years. Florida Bookman Blog is about books, authors, and the topics they raise. I'll write a lot about history, but other things, too. I'll try not to take all of this too seriously, including myself.

feeds.title: Storied Books at the University of Florida Blog
feeds.description: Each item in our collections has meant different things to different people across its lifetime. The Storied Books Project showcases the lives, past and present, that these materials have, and highlights the individuals who animate them. The Rare Book Collection alone is home to more than 60,000 books, manuscripts, and other printed items from around the world.

feeds.title: Florida Writers Association Blog
feeds.description: Florida Writers Association is a nonprofit 501(c)6 serving writers of all genres and all levels. FWA provides a professional atmosphere, a vast networking system, and valuable tools to succeed in today's publishing industry.

feeds.title: The Florida Bookshelf Blog
feeds.description: Read news from the University Press of Florida and UF Press. University Press of Florida is the publisher of books and journals for the State University System of Florida.

feeds.title: Books and Books Key West
feeds.description: We're Key West's locally-owned, nonprofit, independently-minded neighborhood bookstore. Affiliated with Books & Books, one of the nation's great independent bookstores, our home is part of The Studios of Key West, a non-profit arts center and cultural organization.

feeds.title: Laura Schaefer Writer Blog
feeds.description: Laura Schaefer is an expert ghostwriter based in Orlando, Florida who specializes in writing books for coaches, keynote speakers, attorneys, founders, mentors, leadership consultants, associations, and entrepreneurs. She is skilled, caring, fast, and trustworthy.

feeds.title: Orange Blossom Publishing Blog
feeds.description: We are a small press located in Central Florida that publishes adult and children's books. Our focus is on stories about love, wellness, and humor, with a concentration on the female audience. We also offer a variety of services from editing to speaking events to ad design.

feeds.title: Beaches and Reads
feeds.description: Kelly Gamache is a bookworm residing on Florida's Gulf Coast, and welcomes viewers to Beaches and Reads, a haven for those who cherish both stunning beaches and captivating books. Sharing her passion for reading, reviewing, and recommending books, Kelly is surrounded by her family of fellow bookworms and is thrilled to have viewers join her happy place.

feeds.title: Babbling Books Blog
feeds.description: Why, hello there! My name is Taylor and you've probably stumbled on this blog because you love books, well that's great because I do too! I'm a 29-year-old Florida girl. I want this blog and my Goodreads to be a fun place for everyone to look around and find their next great read as well as a forum for us to just share our love for books, whether they be hardback, paperback, or on a digital device.

feeds.title: Sandie Will Books Blog
feeds.description: This blog consists of regular updates, announcements, short stories, and social media/publishing tips by Sandie Will. Dive into a stream of Book Reviews and writing-related content. Sandie Will is a multi-award-winning author of psychological thrillers/horror. She loves tapping into people's fears to scare us all and make us cringe.

feeds.title: Book Briefs
feeds.description: HI. I'm Michelle. I'm a twenty- something new attorney. I love books, dogs, organization, and Florida State Football. Book Briefs is a Young Adult and New Adult Book Review blog, bringing you Young Adult book reviews since 2011

feeds.title: Florida Antiquarian Book Fair Blog
feeds.description: Join us on this blog for regular updates about the Florida Antiquarian Book Fair, the oldest and largest fair of its kind in the southeastern United States. This is your source for the very latest information available about the book fair.

feeds.title: Cozy Florida
feeds.description: A Cozy Mystery Blog by three Florida Authors - Cheryl Hollon, Tara Lush, and Raquel V. Reyes. Hollon writes full-time after an engineering career designing and installing military flight simulators. Lush is a Florida-based author and journalist. She's an RWA Rita finalist, an Amtrak writing fellow, and the winner of the George C. Polk award. Reyes writes stories with Latina characters.

feeds.title: Shannon Esposito Blog
feeds.description: If you're a fan of mysteries set in Florida, you've come to the right place. Grab a beach chair and enjoy escaping to the sunshine state, no airfare is required! Writing allows me to explore a lot of my interests and honestly, they are conflicted. I've always been fascinated by the paranormal... ghosts, psychics, hauntings, curses, magick and unexplained mysteries.

feeds.title: Alexandra Alessandri Blog
feeds.description: Alexandra Alessandri is the author of several books for children. Her books have gone on to receive numerous distinctions, including the Florida Book Award, International Latino Book Award, Américas Award Commendable Title, and the ILA 2022 Children's and Young Adults' Book Award in Primary Fiction.
